issues.failure_explanation: The theorem's first conclusion is that the entire set of Euler segments U^ε_{h,β/h} lies inside U^ε (this is what makes L(h,α)=L and underpins the 'optimal gain' claim). The proof establishes only that each segment S_k lies in the larger set U^{ε+Δ} (with Δ>0 fixed) and that the endpoint satisfies V(x_{k+1}) ≤ ε. Points in the interior of a segment are never shown to have V ≤ ε, so the inclusion into U^ε, and hence the identity L(h,α)=L used for the 'moreover' part, is not proved as written; the proof gives only L(h,α) ≤ \overline{L} > L.
